output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Mailchimp’s main competitors include Constant Contact, Brevo, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and MailerLite. This is a shortlist of prominent alternatives, not a market-share ranking.
caveats: “Main competitors” depends on business needs; this is not an exhaustive list or a definitive ranking.
Vendor comparison pages are promotional, so the shortlist was also checked against Gartner Peer Insights and Zapier.
